name: Being Busy
overview: Scripture warns against the futility of being overly busy with worldly pursuits, as illustrated in Haggai 1:6 where labor yields little lasting benefit, likened to earning wages to put into a bag with holes. The apostle Paul emphasizes that a carnally minded focus leads to death, but a spiritually minded perspective brings life and peace (Romans 8:6). Instead of anxious busyness, believers are called to present their requests to God through prayer and thanksgiving (Philippians 4:6), and to guard against being misled by empty philosophies that distract from Christ (Colossians 2:8). Together, these verses challenge Christians to prioritize spiritual mindfulness over fruitless activity.
